articles.title: Benilde film alumna tops 38th CCP Gawad Alternatibo
articles.summary: Diana Galang wins the Narrative Category at the 38th CCP Gawad Alternatibo for "City's Laundry and Taxes," with the jury citing its precise camera work and calculated editing.

articles.title: '2 Valid IDs' leads 22nd Cinemalaya box office rankings
articles.summary: "2 Valid IDs" starring Pokwang topped box office rankings across seven Metro Manila venues at the 22nd Cinemalaya Philippine Independent Film Festival.

articles.title: '2 Valid IDs' Review: Time Is a Luxury and Privilege That Not Everyone Can Afford
articles.summary: A review of the Cinemalaya film depicting a woman's struggle obtaining identification documents to pay for her husband's medical care.

articles.title: Exclusive interview: Ma-an Asuncion-Dagñalan of Cinemalaya 2026 entry '2 Valid IDs'
articles.summary: Filmmaker Ma-an Asuncion-Dagñalan discusses her Cinemalaya entry addressing broken Philippine identification and healthcare systems through a story about a farmer seeking medical aid.

articles.title: 2 Valid IDs (2026) by Ma-an L. Asuncion-Dagñalan Film Review
articles.summary: A Filipino woman navigates bureaucratic obstacles to obtain identification documents needed to access funds for her husband's medical treatment.

articles.title: How 'Runo!' Makes an Aspin the Heroine of the Story
articles.summary: Student animators Lysa Catolico and Jazmine Gin Pateña premiere their short at the 22nd Cinemalaya, following a rescue aspin searching for her owner through a zombie apocalypse.

articles.title: Two valid IDs and a national ID that failed us
articles.summary: An opinion column on how the Philippine national ID system has failed to resolve documentation issues for citizens, years after implementation.

articles.title: How love for dogs led two Filipino animation students to an international film festival
articles.summary: Lysa Catolico and Jazmine Gin Pateña talk about the passion project that carried them to the 2026 Los Angeles Asian Pacific Film Festival.

articles.title: Philippine animation takes over the 2026 Los Angeles Asian Pacific Film Festival
articles.summary: "Runo!" is selected for the festival's Duty Free program, one of five short films chosen from around the world.

articles.title: In Film, These Filipino Women Are Showing What Women Can Do as Storytellers
articles.summary: A profile of nine Filipino women in cinema, among them the Serrano sisters, whose "Surface Tension" won Best Short Film in QCinema's QCShorts Lokal section.

articles.title: SINEGANG.ph's Best Filipino Shorts of 2025
articles.summary: "City's Laundry and Taxes" makes the year-end list, singled out for using a neighborhood laundromat to examine how traces of abuse are absorbed into everyday labor.

articles.title: How 'Surface Tension' Wades Through Grief and Heartbreak
articles.summary: Sisters Mariana and Gabriela Serrano direct a competitive swimmer home for a wedding, where water becomes the metaphor for trauma, family conflict, and grief.

articles.title: Louise Abuel makes indie comeback in youth-led 'City's Laundry & Taxes'
articles.summary: At 21, award-winning actor Louise Abuel makes his first venture into short films, playing a teenager who must choose between silence and speaking out after a grim discovery in his family's laundromat.
